sokkel-egui.note: Drawn from the spec, one function the rail uses too; `as` is the web's element (rendererSpecific).

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: The small heading over a group of entries: a rail's group, a panel's section, a palette's kind, a table's run of rows. One look for all of them, in capitals, a little tracked, in the faint ink, so a theme or a change reaches every group at once.

anatomy.label: The heading's words, in capitals, tracked wide, at text.xs and 450, in faint.

sokkel-ui: Uppercase and the tracking are CSS (uppercase, tracking-wide); the words are given as written.

as picks the element it is drawn as (p by default; h2, h3, h4, span, div) by where it sits in the page's outline: a heading where it heads a section, a p or a span where it only labels. A renderer with no elements of its own marks a heading its own way, if at all.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
